paragraphs.text: Jaguar is a digital and promotional only creature type for a race of large heavily built cats with a yellowish-brown coat with black spots. Jaguars in eternal legal cards normally fall under the Cat creature type.

Jaguar debuted as a creature type in the Microprose video game . It debuted on Aswan Jaguar which was originally part of the digital Astral set but was also printed as an oversized promotional card. As it was never printed in a legal set, the creature type never appeared in the Comprehensive Rules and technically never received errata but likely would have been errataed to be a cat. Two other jaguar cards were later printed as cats.
Several types of humanoid jaguar folk exist including some of the Cat Warriors of Dominaria , some Nacatl of Alara , and the Malamet of Ixalan .
